basis: Hypoderma larvae typically infest subcutaneous tissue; ocular and neurologic infestation are minority presentations.
Intellectual disability and autism define the disorder; myopia affects 2/4 patients. Facial dysmorphism alone does not establish additional organ dysfunction.
Genetically determined generalized epilepsy is a brain disorder.
Progressive cardiac conduction disease causes atrioventricular block and bradycardia.
Central loss of musical recognition is an agnosia; it does not establish peripheral hearing impairment.
Developmental impairment, language dysfunction, ataxia and seizures are neurologic; hearing and ocular abnormalities are reported below 30%.
Severe alpha-chain deficiency causes fetal anemia; heart failure occurs in 80-99% and hydrocephalus in 30-79%. Hepatomegaly alone does not establish hepatic dysfunction.
Renal tubular salt-handling dysfunction produces defining hyperkalemia, hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis and hypertension.
Postinfectious bronchiolar inflammation and fibrosis cause irreversible airway obstruction; the preceding infection is not ongoing infection.
TAP1-related immunodeficiency commonly causes chronic airway destruction/bronchiectasis (>30%); destructive granulomatous skin ulcers occur in roughly half.
Spastic diplegia and intellectual disability define central neurologic dysfunction; spasticity alone does not establish primary muscle disease.
Adherent scalp scaling involving hair shafts is a cutaneous disorder; its variable underlying causes do not establish an immune mechanism.
Foveal hypoplasia and optic misrouting define ocular disease; supplied ancestry classifies it as an inborn amino-acid transport disorder.
The definition specifies isolated intellectual disability across this X-linked umbrella.
Explicitly autoimmune atherosclerotic disease of arteries; downstream organ infarctions are not established for this concept.
The adenoma originates in adrenal cortex and secretes sex hormones.
Benign ovarian epithelial/stromal neoplasm without endocrine dysfunction; reproductive organs have no axis.
Colon is the tumor's origin; the metastatic destination is unspecified, so no additional organ is assigned.
Defining fibrous dysplasia of bone and intramuscular myxomas both occupy the musculoskeletal axis.
Viral infection causes inflammatory arthritis in 30-79%, with potentially persistent joint dysfunction; transient rash, fever and headache do not qualify.
Mitochondrial marrow-pancreas disorder; hepatic failure 3/5. Renal, cardiac, neurologic and corneal involvement reported at 30-79% omitted under the four-axis cap.
Skin fragility and tooth agenesis define syndrome; myopia 80-99%, ectopia lentis 30-79%, cognitive impairment 30-79%. Hearing impairment is below 30%.
Progressive axial myopia with degenerative chorioretinal changes and posterior staphyloma directly damages the eye.
Disordered calcium deposition causes calcific arteriolopathy and defining ischemic skin necrosis. Renal failure and hyperparathyroidism are separate predisposing diseases.
Esophageal leiomyomas cause obstruction; vulvar lesions have no axis. Alport ancestry without documented renal manifestations leaves renal involvement uncertain.
